edit.title: Edit profile
edit.text: Fill in only what you want to change.
edit.passwordText: You'll sign in with the new username from now on.
edit.firstNameLength: First name must be 3 to 31 characters.
edit.lastNameLength: Last name must be 3 to 31 characters.
edit.userNameInvalid: Username must be 3 to 31 characters, without @.
edit.changedMeanwhile: Your account was changed at the same time. Please try again.

changeEmail.title: Change email
changeEmail.text: We'll send a link to the new address and one to your current address. Your email changes once both are opened.
changeEmail.label: New email
changeEmail.passwordText: Links will be sent to {{email}} and to your current address.
changeEmail.taken: An account with this email already exists.
changeEmail.tooSoon: A link was sent less than a minute ago. Wait a moment and try again.

cancelEmail.title: Cancel the email change?
cancelEmail.text: The links already sent will stop working, and your email stays the same.

pendingEmail.title: Email change in progress
pendingEmail.text: Your email changes to <email/> once both links below are opened.

signInMethods.title: Sign-in methods
signInMethods.onlyMethod: your only way to sign in

link.title: Link {{provider}}?
link.text: You'll be able to sign in with this {{provider}} account too.
link.conflict: This {{provider}} account is linked to another user, or you already have one linked.
link.gitHubInvalid: Linking GitHub failed. Please try again.
link.gitHubEmailNotVerified: GitHub hasn't verified the primary email address of this account.

unlink.title: Unlink {{provider}}?
unlink.text: You won't be able to sign in with this {{provider}} account anymore.
unlink.notLinked: {{provider}} is no longer linked to your account.
unlink.lastMethod: {{provider}} is your only way to sign in, so it can't be unlinked.
